description: This file implements a WAL (Write-Ahead Log) decoder for the etcd storage system, including functions for reading, decoding, and validating log records, handling CRC checks, and detecting torn entries.

classes.name: decoder
classes.description: Implementation of the Decoder interface for reading and validating WAL records.

methods.name: NewDecoderAdvanced
methods.description: Creates a new Decoder with advanced options, including CRC error handling.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new Decoder with default options.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Reads the next record from the WAL.

methods.name: decodeRecord
methods.description: Internal method to decode a single record from the WAL buffer.

methods.name: UpdateCRC
methods.description: Updates the CRC hash with new data.

methods.name: LastCRC
methods.description: Returns the last computed CRC value.

methods.name: LastOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the last valid record.
